data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended January 28, 2024), NVIDIA reported revenue of $60,922 million, gross profit of $44,301 million and operating income of $32,972 million. That works out to a gross margin of about 72.7% ($44,301 million divided by $60,922 million) and an operating margin of about 54.1% ($32,972 million divided by $60,922 million). For comparison, fiscal 2023 revenue was $26,974 million with a gross margin of roughly 56.9% and an operating margin of about 15.7%, so both margins expanded sharply as revenue more than doubled.
